exact_and_derived_rule: Only separately indexed public_exact_members are byte-identical. Derived raw copies remove import.source_modules and import.aot_providers, retain every other decoded field and record original/removed-field SHA and count. A derived audit separately omits exhaustive assertion labels.
followups: Posthoc diagnostics and two source-only future-study designs are evidence/proposals, not extra qualification results.
limits: Full original records remain in the hash-verified private durable archives. Numerical tensors are not independently reconstructed from these JSON reports; source/control assertions and native binaries are independently audited against the originals.
scan: Required case-insensitive byte pattern absent from every public file and every decompressed archive member. No fixture tensor, native binary/cache or whole upstream source included.
